raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the right hemithorax with a visible meniscus sign and a distinct shift of the mediastinum and trachea to the left, which are classic findings of a massive right-sided pleural effusion. Atelectasis would cause a shift toward the opacity, while pneumonia typically does not cause such a significant contralateral shift.
